query: WITH h AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', $1::timestamptz, 'UTC') AS start) UPDATE privacy.read_count c SET alerted = true FROM h WHERE c.hour = h.start AND NOT c.alerted AND c.reads > $2::float8 * greatest($3::float8, (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.reads), 0) FROM privacy.read_count p WHERE p.action = c.action AND p.hour >= h.start - interval '14 days' AND p.hour < h.start) / $4::float8) RETURNING c.id
